decision_rules.ecosystem: Claim an empirically meaningful dynamic wedge only at preregistered beta values where the planner gain is positive and its paired bootstrap interval excludes zero.
decision_rules.technology: Treat increasing returns and concavity as supported only when the paired two-way bootstrap intervals imply positive slopes at fitted z^circ and c>0.
decision_rules.threshold: Report generalized beta_E only when fitted z^circ is interior, both domain slopes there are positive, and weighted curvature is positive; otherwise report the theorem's maintained technology conditions as empirically unsupported.

estimands.interpretation: Identifies the controlled post-training capability frontier for this model/data/optimizer. It does not identify frontier-provider R&D responses.
primary: q_math(z): GSM8K exact-answer accuracy after fixed-budget adaptation
q_code(z): sanitized MBPP pass@1 after fixed-budget adaptation
generalized beta_E from local slopes and curvatures at fitted interior z^circ
global planner versus pure-Nash capability portfolios over observed arms

hypotheses: H1: each held-out capability is increasing and concave in its own-domain share
H2: above beta_E a complementary provider pair beats homogeneous portfolios
H3: the planner's optimal differentiation weakly increases with router responsiveness
H4: for some beta, routed-demand Nash portfolios differ from the global planner pair
randomization: Mixture is assigned at token-block level. Training seed is a paired block shared by every mixture arm; evaluation tasks are identical across arms.
robustness: pooled symmetric quadratic frontier (direct theorem mapping)
nonparametric observed-arm planner and Nash game (primary global comparison)
exploratory paired resampling of training seeds and evaluation tasks, with identification rates and leave-one-seed-out sensitivity reported separately
optional completion-only SFT in a separately initialized design
safety: MBPP execution requires explicit opt-in plus the verified bubblewrap filesystem and network boundary.
title: Fixed-budget randomized capability-mixture experiment
